measured: bash examples/done/test.sh prints 'passed 78, failed 0'; every check asserts on a value read back from a receipt line, a state record, an attestation envelope, an artifact on disk or an exit status, and the gate has three halves: no failure, a floor under the number of checks that ran, and the line this run printed compared against the line the README promises beside the command - so a count agreed between test.sh, provenance.json and the README but printed by none of them is refused
all four entry documents validate against examples/end-to-end/schemas/entry.schema.json with that example's own validator, and none of them names a signer, a key, a store or an adapter

the four doors seal the same four subjects at the same digests, and one run-output predicate with the same materials and the same code version, while carrying four actors, four correlation ids and four notification surfaces; the entry envelope's own digest is a material of every run-output statement, so no two doors' run-output statements agree
the chain the issued credential carries is the chain the envelope declares, in order, plus exactly one hop for the executing unit: 2, 3, 3 and 4 hops at the four doors

along one chain - the external door's, hop by hop - every hop narrows or holds scope, shortens the lifetime and lengthens the chain by one, and the last hop holds exactly the scope the closure's promotion declares

the four units are closed at four dispositions from the published lifecycle set; the unit whose deciding set ran no behavioural check passed every check it had and is still parked at input-required rather than promoted

every subject produced in the period has a statement that resolves: artifacts enumerated from the store's own directory reconcile against the manifest, a file dropped into the artifact store is caught by that enumeration, and the one write path refuses to register a digest no statement resolves for
materiality is read at the decision: three declared values give 1, 2 and 4 full statements while the number of units with a record stays 4 in all three arms

the promotion gate refuses four deliberate breakages, each named by the rule the closure declared - a subject with no run-output statement, a subject whose bytes moved after it was attested, a subject carrying the build predicate, and a statement whose signature no longer covers its payload - promoting nothing and recording the refusal as a run-rejected record

each of the four gate rules is read where it decides, over eight arms: every rule removed in turn lets through exactly the breakage it was the only rule to catch, and refuses it while declared, so no declared rule is a label the gate never consults

the promoted statement verifies from the envelope alone, in another process, with the working directory outside this repository and no adapter of ours imported; one byte of the artifact moved makes that same verification fail with subject_mismatches 1

the number of state records, the head size and the receipt's own line count agree, and an independent verifier that imports no interface and no adapter of ours recomputes the root the store returned, at two doors
an edit mid-history is reported at its index, and a truncated tail recomputes a different root than the head the store published
two writers racing for one head: the first lands, the second is refused 409 head-moved, and the head advances by exactly one

retention is read at the decision: redactable true leaves a tombstone whose record id and proofs survive and takes the words with it, false records a typed refusal and the words stand; after the redaction the reporter's words appear in none of the human door's own files except the pre-redaction dump the check itself asked for
promotion.kind is read where the subject set is decided: branch promotes one subject over four attested records, pull_request two over five, and the promoted subject digest is the same either way

notify.surface is read where the notification is rendered: two surfaces render differently on one receipt at the same cost, and a surface this platform does not serve is refused 422 rather than delivered somewhere
the root hop's obtained_via is read where the root is admitted: direct closes, token_exchange is refused 401 identity-untrusted with no record written

promotion.requires_scope is read where the hop is issued: a scope the chain does not hold is refused 403 policy-denied / scope-must-narrow at platform-pre-issue, before any credential is issued and before any record is written
the receipt's hash chain verifies and a one-character edit is detected; the same idempotency key submitted again appends no record and produces no artifact
the cost on the closing line is the sum of the record lines and the sum of the units' declared costs, and the notification receipt carries the same number
every record kind the README names is written, and every kind written is named, read out of every receipt the run wrote in both directions

the whole closure runs on the second attestation store, which returns an inclusion proof where the first declares them unsupported, seals the same subject bytes and whose statement also verifies from the envelope; on the attested-workload identity binding, which seals the same subjects under the same chain while making no authority call where the first makes one per verification; and on the in-memory state binding, which writes no object to disk and whose head the same independent verifier recomputes
no product name appears in any source file of this example or any artifact the run wrote, outside the standards and adapters tables, scanned word-anchored with the counts printed
every quote in README.md and in this file is grepped verbatim out of the record or the file it names, and provenance.cites is exactly the record ids the example's rows carry, in both directions

every command in the run-steps table, executed as printed from the repository root, prints the last line printed beside it; every flag the README names is declared by the runner's own argparse and every adapter flag names both of its bindings in --help; and the number of checks is the same number in test.sh, in this file and in the README

the wired boundary this example calls is the same file examples/end-to-end/run.py and harness/linked/linked.py call, checked by reading those two files and the loaded function's own filename, not a copy of it

every 'test.sh section N' the README sends a reader to is a section that exists in test.sh, and every G<n> reference in the example's ten prose and code files resolves to a key in the gap table, which is keyed G1..G15 rather than by position

a capability that refuses after the entry was admitted - the signer, on its own published failure path - leaves one run-rejected record naming its problem type, and no receipt of any run ends with more subjects sealed than attested

the standards' versions: every record on file for in-toto, SLSA, DSSE, RFC 9162 and RFC 8693 is a search result rather than a fetched page (STATUS row 14)
that the four units ran as declared: their attempts, stop reasons, costs and check reports arrive on the closure document, and nothing here re-runs, re-measures or re-derives them (gap G1)
that the source tree named as a material of every statement is the tree those units worked on: its digest is declared by the run that produced them and nothing here re-hashes it (gap G7)
promotion success: the branch and the pull request are records naming a target, and nothing is merged, released or deployed (gap G6)
delivery: the notification is a record naming a surface and a recipient; no surface adapter is called and no acknowledgement comes back (gap G5)

that the predicate type used for a run's output would survive contact with a registry: it is ours and unregistered (gap G2)
